# polylane_team_member (Resource)

Manages a user's membership in a Polylane team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polylane_team_member" "platform_alice" {
  workspace_id = "ws_00000000000000000000000000000000"
  team_id      = "team_000000000000000000000000"
  user_id      = "usr_00000000000000000000000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) ID of the team.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user to include in the team.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace containing the team.

### Read-Only

- `added_by` (String) ID of the user who added this member.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the team membership was created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polylane_team_member.platform_alice ws_00000000000000000000000000000000/team_000000000000000000000000/usr_00000000000000000000000000000000
```
